snippet: Current methods for assessing low-abundance proteins in individual cells are limited. As a result, cell functions are often inferred from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, which can be misleading due to the poor cross-gene correlation (different genes in the same cells) between messenger RNA (mRNA) and protein levels.
